text: {"assertions":["A truncated documents bug in search/indexer/chunker.ts caused chunk offsets to stop short of the document length.","The truncated documents bug was caused by a mutable default argument that was shared across multiple function calls.","The bug only appeared on the first request after a cold start.","The fix involved replacing the mutable default argument with an empty default and building the value fresh for each call.","The fix was implemented in PR #2569 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1.","The bug could be reproduced by indexing the long changelog fixture.","The fix eliminated 51 duplicate rows that were being written to the database daily."]}
